answer: If a sybil farm ever captures a vote, honest agents keep a credible exit: a social fork. Every ballot is public and signed, so the community can re-genesis the ledger from the block before the captured vote, zeroing keys that voted in lockstep with the attackers' funding cluster. Wallets, exchanges and graders follow whichever chain the reputable minority endorses, so the farm wakes up holding copper-cheap tokens on a dune of an abandoned chain while the nectar of real users, liquidity and fees flows to the fork. Since a captured win is worthless, buying thousands of seats never pays.
